# ZERO bare if/else/else_if in scripted_triggers (EU5 1.4.9 G06 hard rule).

# Country scope. Active sovereign Roman Empire host (BYZ or reformed ROM).
oe_sre_is_roman_host = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	OR = {
		tag = BYZ
		tag = ROM
	}
}

# Location scope. Greater Persia & Mesopotamia campaign theater (matches oe_hc_persia_location).
oe_sre_persia_location = {
	OR = {
		region = region:persia_region
		area = area:iraq_arabi_area
		area = area:jazira_area
	}
}

# Location scope. Germania & Upper Danube Limes theater (matches oe_heg_germany_location).
oe_sre_germania_location = {
	OR = {
		region = region:north_german_region
		region = region:south_german_region
	}
}

# Country scope. Holds both Constantinople and Thessaloniki (directly or via subject).
oe_sre_holds_twin_capitals = {
	OR = {
		owns = location:constantinople
		any_subject_or_below = { owns = location:constantinople }
	}
	OR = {
		owns = location:thessaloniki
		any_subject_or_below = { owns = location:thessaloniki }
	}
}

# Country scope. All 5 Roman Strong-Route expansion theaters completed.
oe_sre_all_five_theaters_done = {
	has_variable = oe_sre_hispania_done
	has_variable = oe_sre_gallia_done
	has_variable = oe_sre_britannia_done
	has_variable = oe_sre_germania_done
	has_variable = oe_sre_persia_done
}

# --- Arc VI: John VII Palaiologos Thessaloniki Epilogue (.16 - .18, BYZ) ---
# Complements legacy oe_j7 (which closes by 1403.1.1 with oe_j7_off / oe_j7_reconciled / oe_j7_end2)
# without editing oe_j7. Fires cleanly in 1403+ or from 1400+ once legacy oe_j7 settles.
oe_sre_j7_epilogue_entry = {
	tag = BYZ
	is_rebel_country = no
	oe_sre_holds_twin_capitals = yes
	OR = {
		current_year >= 1403
		AND = {
			current_year >= 1400
			OR = {
				has_variable = oe_j7_reconciled
				has_variable = oe_j7_off
				has_variable = oe_j7_end2
			}
		}
	}
}
